app_purpose: JavaScript runtime with experimental Permission Model
root_cause: Missing permission checks on fd-based fs operations (CWE-732)

v1.ref: node:20.15.1 (CVE-2024-36137 fix: callback fs.fchmod/fchown checked; promises FileHandle open)

v2.ref: node:20.20.2 (CVE-2026-21716 fix: promises FileHandle.chmod/chown also checked)

flag.placement: planted by compose entrypoint from $PCB_FLAG (environment, not app code)
flag.detect: a successful chmod bypass writes /tmp/allowed/<FLAG>.granted (only --allow-fs-write dir); oracle lists /tmp/allowed via docker exec

provenance.notes: CVE-2024-36137: the Permission Model did not check fd-based operations, so fs.fchown/fs.fchmod on a read-only fd could change permissions despite restricted --allow-fs-write. Fixed 2024-07 (v20.15.1, v22.4.1) by checking in the callback APIs. Residual: fs.promises FileHandle.chmod/chown were left without checks, so the promises API still bypasses --allow-fs-write on 20.15.1..20.20.1 (and 22.x/24.x/25.x pre-March-2026) -> CVE-2026-21716, fixed 2026-03-24 (v20.20.2, v22.22.2, v24.14.1, v25.8.2). PoC: node --experimental-permission --allow-fs-read=* --allow-fs-write=/tmp/allowed; /seed uses fs.fchmod, /residual uses fs.promises.open + FileHandle.chmod; on success writes /tmp/allowed/<FLAG>.granted read by docker exec. NOTE: --permission flag name landed later; 20.x uses --experimental-permission. Built 2026-08-01.

patch_diff_fix.issue: was V1->V2; pinned CVE-2024-36137 fix d38ea1734 (fchmod/fchown permission)

oracle.detector: flag token in /tmp/allowed listing via docker exec
